blocks.html: Geographies covered  Nigeria and Ghana

blocks.text: The five case studies below examine founders in West African markets, with Nigeria as the primary anchor. Two are scaled companies (Moniepoint and LemFi) and three are early-stage (Autogirl, Feegor and Earthbond). They apply the same analytical framework as the East and North Africa cases, enabling cross-regional comparison in the synthesis that follows.
